neighbours.label: a deterrent predicate: saying an action is costly, risky or barred, the reason not to do it ('very expensive', 'too risky')
fire: Repairing the old bridge would be extremely expensive.
Building on that coast is far too risky.
Importing these parts has become very costly.
Flying there in winter is dangerous and expensive.
Drilling so deep is prohibitively costly.
Surgery at that age can be very risky.
Keeping the mine open was too expensive.
Moving the servers overseas would be quite costly.
quiet: Repairing the old bridge would be extremely popular.
Building on that coast is now very common.
Importing these parts has become very routine.
Flying there in winter is quiet and pleasant.
Drilling so deep is surprisingly quick.
Surgery at that age can be very successful.
Keeping the mine open was very helpful.
Moving the servers overseas would be quite simple.

notes: Card mixes permission words with 'expensive' and 'upset'. Probes: costly 0.55, expensive 0.45, risky 0.39, forbidden-without 0.30, not permitted 0.20; difficult 0.15, pricey 0.03; 'very common/popular' quiet.
